blocks.section: 5. Notice on the Electric and NC Devices
blocks.content: The  instruments  specified  by  our  company  should  be  used  in  the  Electric  Control  Panel. Especially use the specified fuse and never use that of great capacity or a copper wire.

blocks.section: 5. Notice on the Electric and NC Devices
blocks.content: When repairing the electric instrument, switch OFF the power of the Operating Panel. Also switch OFF the Electric Control Panel and then the Power Supply at factory.

blocks.section: 5. Notice on the Electric and NC Devices
blocks.content: Do not change a current setting of the overload relay in the Electric Control Panel and any settings of various volumes.

blocks.section: 5. Notice on the Electric and NC Devices
blocks.content: Do not open the door of the Electric Control Panel or the Operating Panel, if possible. The penetration of foreign material or humidity may result in misoperation.

blocks.section: 5. Notice on the Electric and NC Devices
blocks.content: Special care should be taken in handling the electric instrument of the body.

blocks.section: 5. Notice on the Electric and NC Devices
blocks.content: Clean the fan and filter in the Electric Control Panel regularly.

blocks.section: 5. Notice on the Electric and NC Devices
blocks.content: Check the no of program on the screen of the Operating Panel.
